# Studio board reset

Move completed sketch cards to the lower rail, leave unresolved trial questions on the upper rail and keep specimen identities on the specimen rather than on a removable sketch alone.

## Empty positions
An empty board position means no sketch card is posted there. It does not mean a trial passed, a batch was released or a missing observation was supplied. Handoff of an active experiment follows the separate trial handoff sheet.
